title: AppArmor Causes Auto-Upgrade to Zscaler Client Connector version 3.7.1 for Linux to Fail

blocks.text: Some endpoint devices cannot upgrade to Zscaler Client Connector version 3.7.1 for Linux because of an AppArmor conflict when accessing openssl.cnf by the OpenSSL service.
To resolve this issue, run the following script to update the ZSAUpdater AppArmor profile by adding the read permission to openssl.cnf:
This issue will be fixed in a future release.

blocks.item: Open the ZSAUpdater AppArmor policy file sudo vi /etc/apparmor.d/opt.zscaler.bin.zsupdater.
Insert the policy into the file /etc/ssl/openssl.cnf r,.
Refresh the AppArmor policies for the ZSAUpdater by using the command sudo apparmor_parser -r /etc/apparmor.d/opt.zscaler.bin.zsupdater.
